concerns.location: tasks.md:all tasks vs plan.md:T011 / Summary step 3
concerns.text: The plan's independent evaluation set (independent_eval.csv with feature-independent N(0,1) targets) and task T011 (evaluate trained models on it, append report section) have NO corresponding task in tasks.md. This is a substantive research deliverable (breaking simulation circularity, methodology-f4c7012e), not a platform-owned concern; an implementer following tasks.md cannot produce it.

Plan T001b builds the FR-011 simulated set from a verified HuggingFace SMILES parquet (200 molecules, seed 42); tasks.md T003 instead generates 100 synthetic hosts with descriptors 'from real host descriptor statistics in data/raw/descriptors_added.csv' — a different source and count, and an undefined input when the scrape legitimately yields zero records (descriptors_added.csv would be empty). The plan element is not covered by any task as specified.

concerns.location: tasks.md:Revision behavior vs constitution Principle III / plan.md Constitution Check
concerns.text: Constitution Principle III requires datasets to be checksummed with checksums recorded under data/. tasks.md removes all checksum work as 'platform-owned' (state.yaml hashing), but data/ checksums are a project deliverable per the constitution and plan's utils.compute_checksum() claim; no task produces them.

T004 requires model_runs.json to conform to BOTH model_output.schema.yaml and output.schema.yaml, which have conflicting required shapes (nested metrics vs top-level r2_mean; output.schema.yaml sets additionalProperties: false). The coverage claim is internally unsatisfiable; pick one schema or split outputs.

Plan task T010 (citation verification) is dropped with only a generic 'platform-owned' note. The Reference-Validator gate is indeed platform-run per the constitution, but tasks.md should explicitly state the handoff (citations in research.md are subject to the platform gate) rather than silently orphaning the plan element.
